sourceOccurrences.label: Support, forest paths and ray specialization
sourceOccurrences.locator: Named statement start lines in the pinned source: 23, 35, 41, 50, 68, 79, 86, 96, 116, 140, 152, 182, 193, 202
sourceOccurrences.note: XHFN and its proof cover positive-coordinate support; 8KVE covers unique paths, disconnected components and extended susceptibility. The deterministic path equivalence is explicitly valid without countability. TGL4 and the path description cover ray support, ordered/unordered endpoint distances and the geometric endpoint sum, including zero/one parameters and arbitrary diagonals.
